segments.name: Telecommunications
segments.description: Provides telecommunications services to customers in Brazil including mobile, fixed-line, broadband and data services.
segments.evidence: Information technology is essential for conducting our business and providing our services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for telecommunications services including mobile, fixed-line, broadband, data services and international interconnection fees, with revenue generated primarily in Brazilian reais.
revenueModel.evidence: 99.7% of our revenue was generated in reais, except income derived from hedging transactions, international long-distance interconnection fees and services to customers outside of Brazil.
